seo.title: Yaren homeless help - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified shelter, food, health, safety, legal and social support for people experiencing homelessness in Yaren.

page.heading: YAREN - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: Immediate danger or medical emergency: contact Nauru Police or RON Hospital. Legal help: Office of the Public Legal Defender in Yaren.
page.notice: Information and availability can change. Call before travelling when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, treatment or job.
page.intro: Nauru does not publish a general homelessness shelter or central intake service. Family and community networks are important, but people who are unsafe should contact police, RON Hospital or the domestic-violence support network. Social Welfare and the Public Legal Defender are both based in Yaren.
page.footer: Main sources: Government of Nauru Department of Health, Social Welfare Division, Department of Justice and Border Control and published victim-support guidance.

entries.title: Republic of Nauru Hospital
entries.description: The country's public hospital and main point for urgent medical care. Ask hospital staff for a social worker or protection referral when safety or housing is also a concern.
entries.how_to_access: Attend the emergency department or contact police if immediate safety is at risk.

entries.title: Republic of Nauru Hospital
entries.description: Public hospital for emergency and general medical services.
entries.how_to_access: Attend the hospital for urgent care.

entries.title: Social Welfare Division
entries.description: Government social-welfare administration in Yaren. Contact the division to ask about available assistance and eligibility.
entries.how_to_access: Visit or contact the division and ask for an assessment. Bring any identification available.

entries.title: Office of the Public Legal Defender
entries.description: Legal aid, advice and assistance for eligible people and court-appointed cases.
entries.how_to_access: Contact the office and explain the legal issue and financial circumstances.

entries.title: Nauru domestic-violence support
entries.description: Nauru Police Domestic Violence Unit and Women and Survivors with Disabilities Association can provide or arrange protection, counselling and welfare support.
entries.how_to_access: Ask Nauru Police for the Domestic Violence Unit or request referral to WASDA. Do not delay emergency medical care.
